scope: Offline synthetic wallet library gates; no chain funding or broadcast
commands: cargo test --release --locked -p darkcall-auction-core -p darkcall-input-tool -p darkcall-native-gate -p darkcall-wallet-bridge -j 2

new_pin.purpose: strict application claim/acceptance signatures; separate from native FROST keys

limitations: Scanner uses a trusted provider/checkpoint and is not a consensus verifier.
Scanner persistence, RPC sync, finality and reorg/spent-funding reconciliation are not wired.
Funding claim authenticates intent; chain inclusion, unspentness, client ZK and delivered-share checks remain independent admission requirements.
Receipt signatures attest operator acceptance, not a public proof of funding.
Complete frozen root, omission detection and actual MPC/native public bundle authentication remain.
All tests use synthetic funding; no network funds received or transaction broadcast.
